description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with solid knowledge of math and physics, basic theory and methods of electronics and information systems. They should be familiar with computer application technology after strictly trained in scientific research experiments. They are qualified in information science, electronic engineering, computer technology or other related fields. Focusing on the combination of theory and technology, and technology and system, under the support of the advantage in the information and communications technology and information and communication system integration, it trains professionals to have a solid theoretical basis in information science, to be familiar with the design, development and integration technology of information system, so that they are capable of design, development, maintenance in the IT industry, the community dedicated information systems and networks.

duration.text: The Electronic Science and Technology at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
